apiKeyHelp: The API key is sent as X-API-Key header. Give its user only the privileges it needs.
fingerprintHelp: Must match the certificate the firewall presents. Read it with the button and compare it with System > Certificates on the firewall.
graceHelp: Avoids false absences when a phone briefly sleeps. 0 = absent as soon as it is not seen.
hostHelp: IP address or host name of the pfSense web interface
powerHelp: Creates the control.reboot and control.halt buttons. Anyone who can write states can then switch off your network.
requirementText: Requires the pfSense REST API package (pfrest, v2.x) installed on the firewall. Create an API key under System > REST API > Keys.
ruleFilterHelp: Leave empty for all rules. Example: [iob] to expose only rules you tagged.
tlsModeHelp: pfSense uses a self-signed certificate by default. Pinning its fingerprint keeps the connection verified.
trackAllHelp: Otherwise devices are created only for the MAC addresses in the presence list
